datasets.title: M1-67 in the infrared
datasets.description: ESA/Webb's picture of the nebula around WR 124, NIRCam 0.9, 1.5, 2.1, 3.35, 4.44 and 4.7 µm with MIRI 7.7, 11, 12 and 18 µm: gas and dust the star threw off, in clumps. It lies on the walls of a model: Zavala et al. (2022) fit the nebula's spectra with three nested pairs of hollow lobes and a waist about them, seen edge-on, each expanding faster the farther it is from the star. On each sight line the nearer half of the model's gas and the farther half stand at their own middles; those two depths hold the picture's light. No clump's own depth is measured: the model says where gas is, not which clump is in front. The picture's small stars are removed; the bright ones stay.
datasets.summary: Webb's picture on the walls of a model fitted to the nebula's spectra: the nearer and farther halves of its gas.
